actions.action: Lift plant from decorative pot and check soil moisture 5 cm deep
Empty water pooled in outer pot
Squeeze stem bases and inspect roots for rot
If rot found, trim rotten roots and stems with clean scissors
If rot found, repot into draining pot with 1:1 universal soil and perlite
Water only when top 5 cm is dry (about every 3-4 weeks in winter)
Pour out water left in saucer or outer pot 15 minutes after watering
Cut yellowed stems at the soil line
Watch older leaves with yellow tips and remove fully yellow ones

reason: The answer correctly identifies overwatering with early root rot. It gives the key fixes: less frequent watering, a root inspection and repotting. Its advice to cut yellowing stems goes against the thread's warning, but it is only mildly stressful and not likely to make the plant worse.
